en.headline: San Tin Tech City land prices ‘negotiable’, chairman seeks chip and drone firms
en.dek: Sunny Chai said the 210-hectare site will focus on mid- and downstream advanced manufacturing and that the company has already approached one or two leading enterprises.
body: The chairman of the newly established San Tin Tech City company said on Saturday that land prices at the 210-hectare site are negotiable and that the company has already contacted one or two leading enterprises about locating there.

Speaking on a television programme, Sunny Chai Ngai-chiu said the park would concentrate on mid- and downstream advanced manufacturing, aiming to attract high-tech industries such as chips, drones and new-energy vehicles. He cited the attractive land price offered for the Sha Ling supercomputing centre earlier this year as a reference that could help lower manufacturing costs.

Chai noted that the first board meeting had been held successfully in July and that the chief executive and other senior management are expected to be appointed in October or November. He also highlighted the advantages of the Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA), which he said many overseas and mainland firms have overlooked.

Looking ahead, Chai estimated that Hong Kong’s innovation and technology land supply would increase four-fold over the next decade and that the number of research talent needed would rise from about 50,000 to at least 200,000.

zh.headline: 查毅超：新田科技城地價有得傾 已接觸一兩間龍頭企業
zh.dek: 新田科技城公司主席指園區集中中下游先進製造，冀吸引芯片、無人機及新能源車等高新產業落戶。
body: 新田科技城有限公司主席查毅超周六在電視節目表示，園區地價「有得傾」，公司已接觸一兩間龍頭企業洽談落戶事宜。
查毅超指，佔地210公頃的新田科技城將集中發展中下游落地的先進製造業，期望吸引芯片、無人機及新能源汽車等高新科技企業。他以今年4月沙嶺超算中心具吸引力的地價作比較，期望新田地價亦可作為參考，以降低企業製造成本。
他透露，公司首場董事會已於7月順利召開，預計10至11月敲定行政總裁及其他高管團隊。查毅超亦提到不少海內外企業忽略了《內地與香港關於建立更緊密經貿關係的安排》（CEPA）的優勢。
展望未來，查毅超預計未來10年本港創科用地將增加四倍，所需科研人才由現時約5萬人大幅增至起碼20萬人。
